original_ai_output.title_zh: 马哈马呼吁非洲各国政府将医疗视为投资而非预算成本
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳总统约翰·马哈马呼吁非洲各国政府和投资者重新思考医疗融资，将医疗行业视为经济投资而非国家预算的单纯成本。他同时提出应把卫生主权作为非洲的优先事项。该报道目前为单一来源。

key_facts.fact: 加纳总统马哈马呼吁非洲各国政府将医疗视为投资而非预算成本
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Mahama urges African governments to treat healthcare as an investment, not budget cost

key_facts.fact: 马哈马呼吁政府和投资者将医疗行业视为经济投资，而非国家预算的单纯成本
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: President John Mahama has called for a major rethink of healthcare financing in Africa, urging governments and investors to treat the sector as an economic investment rather than merely a cost to national budgets.

key_facts.fact: 马哈马提出应把卫生主权作为非洲的优先事项
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Make health sovereignty a priority for Africa – Mahama
